### Figures (PNG + SVG)

diagrams and 3 `Formal Supplement` contract diagrams. `FigureSpec.section`,
`FigureSpec.caption`, and `FigureSpec.alt_text` own the grouping and metadata.

## Generated by `scripts/z_generate_manuscript_variables.py`

- `output/data/manuscript_variables.json`
- `output/manuscript/*.md` (hydrated manuscript sections)
- The first hydrated section carries a source fingerprint consumed by the
  render freshness gate.

## Generated by `scripts/build_dashboard.py`

- `output/web/dashboard.html` — styled dashboard with figure gallery and concept inventory
- `output/web/dashboard_data.json` — compact JSON payload for programmatic consumers

## Generated by `scripts/generate_api_docs.py`

- `output/docs/api_reference.md` — full source reference from conceptual inventory
- `output/docs/api_glossary.md` — auto-generated API glossary (when available)

## Generated by `scripts/00_preflight.py`

- Exit code 0/1 only; checks manuscript rendering prerequisites

## Generated by the template renderer

- `output/manuscript/` — hydrated numbered manuscript sections
- `output/web/` — combined and per-section HTML plus dashboard assets
- `output/pdf/prior_cognitive_art_combined.pdf` — combined rendered manuscript
- `output/slides/` — section slide decks when the project render profile enables them

## Canonical orchestration

`scripts/build_publication_package.py` runs analysis, API documentation,
hydration, rendering, dashboard generation, project web styling, manifest
stamping, and validation in that order. Derived outputs are regenerated; they
are not hand-edited.
